title: The Identifiability Budget: An Audit Framework for Mechanistic AI and Experimental Design
description: Research preprint defining an intervention-budget audit for discriminating a finite set of candidate mechanisms under explicit Gaussian observation assumptions. Numerical checks are synthetic and do not validate a real biological or physical mechanism. This file is metadata preparation only; it does not represent a Zenodo deposition or DOI assignment.
